messages:
Maya: Hey @eng, flagging RiverPad onboarding — their Node SDK init sometimes returns 401 then succeeds on immediate retry. Customer rotated keys during onboarding but says tokens look valid. Any quick checks?
Jorge: 401 on init usually means token signature/claims mismatch or clock skew. Do we have the request headers + raw token sample?
Maya: Pasting sanitized curl they ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSU..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/init
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json
{ "error": "unauthorized" }
```
They rotate ephemeral creds every 60s via an internal refresh process.
Chad: Two quick things: 1) If the token has `iat`/`exp` we should check their system clock, 2) if they rotate keys rapidly, there can be a small window where cached public keys haven't propagated.
Sam: SDK note — older Node SDK (v2.0.1) will reuse cached JWKS for 2m by default; if they rotate frequently that can cause signature fails until cache refresh. Which SDK version are they on?
Maya: They said 2.0.1. Good catch.
Jorge: Can you ask for the `Date` header from their failing request and server's wall clock? If `Date` differs by >30s we will reject based on `exp` check. Also send the X-Request-Id so we can correlate logs on our side.
Maya: Asked them for headers and `ntp` status. They replied: `Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2025 18:02:03 GMT` from their app host; their NTP service had drift.
Chad: Tell them to run `sudo ntpdate -u pool.ntp.org` or enable chronyd. That will likely fix immediate 401s. Also, Sam — can the SDK add a soft retry on signature errors for 1 retry with jitter? If rotation and cache propagation cause transient signature failures, a retry after 100-300ms often clears it.
Sam: We can add a 1-retry jitter for `401` only when we detect recent key-rotation header. But need to be careful not to retry true auth errors. Maybe tie to an `x-key-rotated` hint header from their refresh flow. I'll open a PR with opt-in toggle.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of sdk@2.0.2-inc-retry scheduled to staging at 2025-07-13T02:30Z :rocket:
Maya: Customer applied `ntpdate` and confirmed clocks were within 2s. They also bumped SDK to staging build and the init flow is stable in our repro. No 401s over next 30 minutes. :tada:
Jorge: I'll add a short doc blurb in our onboarding checklist: "Ensure system clock synced; if you rotate keys <2m, consider SDK cache settings or enable key-propagation hooks".
Maya: Marking as resolved on our side, will follow up if they see a recurrence. Thanks team.
